author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
Wild tangents, baffling interruptions, and a healthy dose of chaos grip Bethesda Game Studios when Sheogorath, the great Prince of Madness pays an unexpected visit to the office.  

There's always time for a riddle from the Mad Prince, do you dare play his games? The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered comes to Nintendo Switch 2 on August 11, bringing Bethesda Game Studios’ classic open-world RPG to a new platform with stunning new visuals, refined gameplay and the complete story experience.
